items.q: His brother, Charles Moore, lives right next to St. Vincent right there on Magazine Street. So that's about all I know in the neighborhood.

ctx.x: ...Boidal Street, yeah. His brother, Charles Moore, lives right next to St. Vincent right there on Magazine Street. So that's about all I know in the neighborhood.

But I was going to say, when you were growing up as a kid, you were talking about your father playing piano. Did other people in the neighborhood play piano? Were the other piano players? Was that kind of a tradition?
